dedupe_keys.name: nordic44 grid model matched to 2015 electricity market data

description: Nordic44 provides an equivalent Nordic electricity-grid model matched to hourly market and power-flow conditions for 2015. The KTH, Statnett, NTNU and ALSETLab collaborators publish base cases and dated snapshots in Modelica, CIM 14 and PSS/E formats, with Excel source and result tables. A companion Python toolbox reads Nord Pool data, maps them to the grid model and writes simulation cases. The data and model archive are free under CC BY-NC 4.0; the current GitHub processing code is GPL 3.0 or later. Geographic coverage is an equivalent Nordic network, not a detailed map of every asset. The year-specific archive and legacy market interfaces limit current operational use. PSS/E and PSS ODMS paths require additional proprietary licences; Modelica cases need a compatible environment. A reviewer-assessed use is initializing dynamic or power-flow simulations under varied historical operating conditions. The repository explicitly uses model-openipsl. No model or conversion script was run.
inputs: Hourly Nord Pool market data and Nordic44 base-case grid parameters
licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (Zenodo data/model archive); GPL-3.0-or-later (GitHub processing code)
